## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL, Growth/Momentum tilt. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Top performers are Technology) — confirms a tech-led thrust but concentration warns against broad conviction.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Technology lead: PLTR (1W: +39.46% | 1M: +38.20%) ABOVE TREND; SHOP (1W: +32.62% | 1M: +26.64%) ABOVE TREND. Materials strong: NEM (1W: +22.95% | 1M: +23.06%) ABOVE TREND; FCX (1W: +10.80% | 1M: +14.89%) ABOVE TREND. Energy positive: XOM (1W: +3.05% | 1M: +15.06%) ABOVE TREND; CVX (1W: +0.90% | 1M: +10.49%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Utilities lag: SRE (1W: -3.90% | 1M: -10.50%) BELOW TREND; VST (1W: -8.38% | 1M: -10.07%) BELOW TREND. Real Estate weak: PLD (1W: -3.74% | 1M: -1.50%) BELOW TREND; CCI (1W: -4.08% | 1M: -7.59%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Staples mixed-to-weak: MO (1W: -3.98% | 1M: -8.71%) BELOW TREND; KHC (1W: -5.64% | 1M: +0.32%) CORRECTION.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: PLTR (1W: +39.46% | 1M: +38.20%) ABOVE TREND; SHOP (1W: +32.62% | 1M: +26.64%) ABOVE TREND; NEM (1W: +22.95% | 1M: +23.06%) ABOVE TREND; NOW (1W: +11.60% | 1M: +18.32%) ABOVE TREND; PANW (1W: +10.92% | 1M: +18.14%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology) — signals concentrated momentum.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: CVS (1W: -9.21% | 1M: -7.57%) BELOW TREND; VST (1W: -8.38% | 1M: -10.07%) BELOW TREND; KHC (1W: -5.64% | 1M: +0.32%) CORRECTION; RCL (1W: -4.94% | 1M: +7.93%) CORRECTION; GOOGL (1W: -4.28% | 1M: +0.10%) CORRECTION. Weakness concentrated in defensive/real-estate names and select high-multiple names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Highest 1W movers: PLTR (1W: +39.46% | 1M: +38.20%) ABOVE TREND; SHOP (1W: +32.62% | 1M: +26.64%) ABOVE TREND; NEM (1W: +22.95% | 1M: +23.06%) ABOVE TREND; NOW (1W: +11.60% | 1M: +18.32%) ABOVE TREND; PANW (1W: +10.92% | 1M: +18.14%) ABOVE TREND. Note major divergence among large-cap leaders (AAPL, GOOGL, AMZN, META, TSLA) with 1W vs 1M mismatches—this is a MAJOR divergence, so treat moves as tactical rather than confirmation of a broad regime.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed but strong on momentum names; Tech (1W: +7.50% | 1M: +5.66%) with leadership concentrated in discrete winners. AAPL (1W: +1.68% | 1M: -2.15%) RECOVERY; MSFT (1W: +3.78% | 1M: +31.41%) ABOVE TREND; NVDA (1W: +5.28% | 1M: +3.12%) ABOVE TREND; GOOGL (1W: -4.28% | 1M: +0.10%) CORRECTION; META (1W: +0.79% | 1M: -11.10%) RECOVERY — internal rotation within Tech.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials modestly positive (1W: +0.42% | 1M: +4.12%) with pockets of strength. JPM (1W: +2.03% | 1M: +6.93%) ABOVE TREND; V (1W: -1.19% | 1M: +3.54%) CORRECTION; MA (1W: -1.37% | 1M: +6.92%) CORRECTION — style mixed between cyclicals and payment processors.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare constructive but mixed: Healthcare (1W: +2.79% | 1M: +5.30%). JNJ (1W: +2.91% | 1M: +1.88%) ABOVE TREND; LLY (1W: +9.86% | 1M: +3.65%) ABOVE TREND; PFE (1W: +8.07% | 1M: +13.87%) ABOVE TREND; UNH (1W: -1.59% | 1M: -3.74%) BELOW TREND — watch political/regulatory headlines for names under pressure.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor exposure to selective tech momentum and cyclicals while monitoring concentration risk; favor PLTR (1W: +39.46% | 1M: +38.20%) ABOVE TREND, SHOP (1W: +32.62% | 1M: +26.64%) ABOVE TREND and XOM (1W: +3.05% | 1M: +15.06%) ABOVE TREND, and reduce exposure to crowded small-cap tech positions if sizing is large. Style: Growth/Momentum tilt but narrow leadership means reduce exposure to single-stock concentration and monitor for trend breaks.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: PLTR (1W: +39.46% | 1M: +38.20%) ABOVE TREND — watch follow-through; LLY (1W: +9.86% | 1M: +3.65%) ABOVE TREND — earnings/sentiment momentum; NVDA (1W: +5.28% | 1M: +3.12%) ABOVE TREND — AI narrative confirmed by news. BEARISH: GOOGL (1W: -4.28% | 1M: +0.10%) CORRECTION — watch if correction widens; CVS (1W: -9.21% | 1M: -7.57%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Technology — concentrated momentum names; Materials — NEM/FCX strength. BEARISH: Utilities and Real Estate — continued softness in SRE (1W: -3.90% | 1M: -10.50%) BELOW TREND and PLD (1W: -3.74% | 1M: -1.50%) BELOW TREND.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA (1W: +5.28% | 1M: +3.12%) ABOVE TREND — watch sustain above recent weekly highs for momentum continuation. AAPL (1W: +1.68% | 1M: -2.15%) RECOVERY — watch whether 1M turns positive to confirm reversal. JPM (1W: +2.03% | 1M: +6.93%) ABOVE TREND — monitor follow-through on financials’ leadership. SHOP (1W: +32.62% | 1M: +26.64%) ABOVE TREND — watch for volume-confirmed continuation or sharp mean reversion given outsized move.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
JNJ (+80): JNJ (1W: +2.91% | 1M: +1.88%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment and price confirming after FDA/settlement headlines. NVDA (+60): NVDA (1W: +5.28% | 1M: +3.12%) ABOVE TREND — bullish AI data-center narrative confirming price strength. XOM (+55): XOM (1W: +3.05% | 1M: +15.06%) ABOVE TREND — earnings/buyback narrative confirming accumulation.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
AAPL (-50): AAPL (1W: +1.68% | 1M: -2.15%) RECOVERY — news-negative but price showing short-term bounce (divergence). PLTR (-50): PLTR (1W: +39.46% | 1M: +38.20%) ABOVE TREND — negative commentary amid heavy outperformance (distribution risk). UNH (-50): UNH (1W: -1.59% | 1M: -3.74%) BELOW TREND — bearish headlines confirming price pressure.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with a Growth/Momentum tilt given concentrated tech leadership. PLTR (1W: +39.46% | 1M: +38.20%) ABOVE TREND, SHOP (1W: +32.62% | 1M: +26.64%) ABOVE TREND and NEM (1W: +22.95% | 1M: +23.06%) ABOVE TREND are showing the most relative strength. Key risk: narrow leadership and several large-cap divergences (AAPL, GOOGL, AMZN, META) plus mixed sentiment on some winners — monitor for trend breaks.
